\"/assets/blog/dynamic-routing/cover.jpg\"\n---\n\n# React服务端渲染与Next.js深度解析（三）：样式优化与部署\n\n## 前言\n\n在上一篇文章中，我们了解了Next.js的数据获取方法和路由系统。本文将继续深入探讨Next.js的样式优化、图片优化、构建配置、性能监控和实际应用案例，帮助你全面掌握Next.js的高级特性和最佳实践。\n\n## Next.js样式与优化\n\n### 全局样式\n\n```css\n/* styles/globals.css */\n/* 全局样式 */\nhtml,\nbody {\n  padding: 0;\n  margin: 0;\n  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Oxygen,\n    Ubuntu, Cantarell, Fira Sans, Droid Sans, Helvetica Neue, sans-serif;\n}\n\na {\n  color: inherit;\n  text-decoration: none;\n}\n\n/* 响应式设计 */\n@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {\n  html {\n    color-scheme: dark;\n  }\n  body {\n    color: white;\n    background: black;\n  }\n}\n```\n\n```tsx\n// pages/_app.tsx - 导入全局样式\nimport '../styles/globals.css'\nimport type { AppProps } from 'next/app'\n\nexport default function App({ Component, pageProps }: AppProps) {\n  return <Component {...pageProps} />\n}\n```\n\n### 图片优化\n\n```tsx\n// components/OptimizedImage.tsx\nimport Image from 'next/image'\n\ntype OptimizedImageProps = {\n  src: string\n  alt: string\n  width: number\n  height: number\n  priority?: boolean\n}\n\nexport default function OptimizedImage({ \n  src, \n  alt, \n  width, \n  height, \n  priority = false \n}: OptimizedImageProps) {\n  return (\n    <Image\n      src={src}\n      alt={alt}\n      width={width}\n      height={height}\n      priority={priority} // 优先加载重要图片\n      placeholder=\"blur\" // 加载时显示模糊占位符\n      blurDataURL=\"data:image/jpeg;base64,\"\n    />\n  )\n}\n\n// 使用示例\nfunction ProductCard({ product }) {\n  return (\n    <div>\n      <OptimizedImage\n        src={product.image}\n        alt={product.name}\n        width={300}\n        height={200}\n        priority={product.featured}\n      />\n      <h3>{product.name}</h3>\n      <p>{product.price}</p>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n```\n\n## Next.js部署与优化\n\n### 构建优化\n\n```json\n// next.config.js\n/** @type {import('next').NextConfig} */\nconst nextConfig = {\n  // 启用实验性功能\n  experimental: {\n    // 启用App Router (Next.js 13+)\n    appDir: true,\n    // 优化服务器组件\n    serverComponentsExternalPackages: ['some-package']\n  },\n  \n  // 图片优化配置\n  images: {\n    domains: ['example.com', 'cdn.example.com'],\n    formats: ['image/webp', 'image/avif'],\n    deviceSizes: [640, 750, 828, 1080, 1200, 1920, 2048, 3840],\n    imageSizes: [16, 32, 48, 64, 96, 128, 256, 384]\n  },\n  \n  // 压缩配置\n  compress: true,\n  \n  // PWA配置\n  pwa: {\n    dest: 'public',\n    disable: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development'\n  },\n  \n  // 环境变量\n  env: {\n    CUSTOM_KEY: process.env.CUSTOM_KEY\n  },\n  \n  // 重定向\n  async redirects() {\n    return [\n      {\n        source: '/old-path',\n        destination: '/new-path',\n        permanent: true\n      }\n    ]\n  },\n  \n  // 重写\n  async rewrites() {\n    return [\n      {\n        source: '/api/blog/:path*',\n        destination: 'https://external-api.com/blog/:path*'\n      }\n    ]\n  },\n  \n  // 头部配置\n  async headers() {\n    return [\n      {\n        source: '/api/:path*',\n        headers: [\n          { key: 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin', value: '*' },\n          { key: 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods', value: 'GET,OPTIONS,PATCH,DELETE,POST,PUT' }\n        ]\n      }\n    ]\n  },\n  \n  // Webpack配置\n  webpack: (config, { buildId, dev, isServer, defaultLoaders, webpack }) => {\n    // 自定义Webpack配置\n    return config\n  }\n}\n\nmodule.exports = nextConfig\n```\n\n### 性能监控\n\n```tsx\n// components/PerformanceMonitor.tsx\nimport { useEffect } from 'react'\nimport { useRouter } from 'next/router'\n\nexport default function PerformanceMonitor() {\n  const router = useRouter()\n  \n  useEffect(() => {\n    // 监控路由变化\n    const handleRouteChange = (url: string) => {\n      // 记录页面访问\n      if (window.gtag) {\n        window.gtag('config', 'GA_MEASUREMENT_ID', {\n          page_path: url,\n        })\n      }\n      \n      // 记录性能指标\n      if (window.performance) {\n        const navigation = window.performance.getEntriesByType('navigation')[0] as PerformanceNavigationTiming\n        const loadTime = navigation.loadEventEnd - navigation.fetchStart\n        \n        // 发送性能数据\n        if (window.gtag) {\n          window.gtag('event', 'page_load_time', {\n            value: Math.round(loadTime),\n            custom_map: { custom_parameter_1: 'page_load_time' }\n          })\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    \n    router.events.on('routeChangeComplete', handleRouteChange)\n    \n    return () => {\n      router.events.off('routeChangeComplete', handleRouteChange)\n    }\n  }, [router.events])\n  \n  return null\n}\n\n// pages/_app.tsx - 使用性能监控\nimport '../styles/globals.css'\nimport type { AppProps } from 'next/app'\nimport PerformanceMonitor from '../components/PerformanceMonitor'\n\nexport default function App({ Component, pageProps }: AppProps) {\n  return (\n    <>\n      <PerformanceMonitor />\n      <Component {...pageProps} />\n    </>\n  )\n}\n```\n\n## 实际应用案例\n\n### 电商网站\n\n```tsx\n// pages/products/[slug].tsx - 产品详情页\nimport { GetStaticProps, GetStaticPaths } from 'next'\nimport { GetProductBySlug, GetAllProductSlugs } from '../../lib/products'\nimport Image from 'next/image'\nimport { useState } from 'react'\nimport { useCart } from '../../context/CartContext'\n\ntype ProductProps = {\n  product: {\n    id: string\n    slug: string\n    name: string\n    description: string\n    price: number\n    images: string[]\n    inStock: boolean\n  }\n}\n\nexport default function ProductPage({ product }: ProductProps) {\n  const [selectedImage, setSelectedImage] = useState(0)\n  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState(1)\n  const { addToCart } = useCart()\n  \n  const handleAddToCart = () => {\n    addToCart({\n      id: product.id,\n      name: product.name,\n      price: product.price,\n      quantity\n    })\n  }\n  \n  return (\n    <div className=\"product-page\">\n      <div className=\"product-images\">\n        <div className=\"main-image\">\n          <Image\n            src={product.images[selectedImage]}\n            alt={product.name}\n            width={600}\n            height={600}\n            priority\n          />\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"image-thumbnails\">\n          {product.images.map((image, index) => (\n            <button\n              key={index}\n              className={index === selectedImage ? 'active' : ''}\n              onClick={() => setSelectedImage(index)}\n            >\n              <Image\n                src={image}\n                alt={`${product.name} ${index + 1}`}\n                width={100}\n                height={100}\n              />\n            </button>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n      </div>\n      \n      <div className=\"product-info\">\n        <h1>{product.name}</h1>\n        <p className=\"price\">${product.price.toFixed(2)}</p>\n        <p className=\"description\">{product.description}</p>\n        \n        {product.inStock ? (\n          <div className=\"purchase-options\">\n            <div className=\"quantity-selector\">\n              <label>Quantity:</label>\n              <select \n                value={quantity} \n                onChange={(e) => setQuantity(Number(e.target.value))}\n              >\n                {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(num => (\n                  <option key={num} value={num}>{num}</option>\n                ))}\n              </select>\n            </div>\n            \n            <button \n              className=\"add-to-cart-btn\"\n              onClick={handleAddToCart}\n            >\n              Add to Cart\n            </button>\n          </div>\n        ) : (\n          <p className=\"out-of-stock\">Out of Stock</p>\n        )}\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// 静态生成所有产品页面\nexport async function getStaticPaths() {\n  const slugs = await GetAllProductSlugs()\n  \n  const paths = slugs.map(slug => ({\n    params: { slug }\n  }))\n  \n  return {\n    paths,\n    fallback: 'blocking' // 新产品可以按需生成\n  }\n}\n\n// 获取产品数据\nexport async function getStaticProps({ params }) {\n  const product = await GetProductBySlug(params.slug)\n  \n  if (!product) {\n    return { notFound: true }\n  }\n  \n  return {\n    props: {\n      product\n    },\n    revalidate: 3600 // 每小时重新生成\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### 博客系统\n\n```tsx\n// pages/blog/index.tsx - 博客列表页\nimport { GetStaticProps } from 'next'\nimport { GetAllPosts, GetPaginatedPosts } from '../../lib/posts'\nimport Link from 'next/link'\nimport { useState, useEffect } from 'react'\nimport { useRouter } from 'next/router'\n\ntype BlogProps = {\n  initialPosts: {\n    id: string\n    title: string\n    excerpt: string\n    publishedAt: string\n    slug: string\n  }[]\n  totalPages: number\n}\n\nexport default function Blog({ initialPosts, totalPages }: BlogProps) {\n  const [posts, setPosts] = useState(initialPosts)\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)\n  const [page, setPage] = useState(1)\n  const router = useRouter()\n  \n  // 加载更多文章\n  const loadMorePosts = async () => {\n    setLoading(true)\n    const nextPage = page + 1\n    \n    try {\n      const newPosts = await GetPaginatedPosts(nextPage)\n      setPosts([...posts, ...newPosts])\n      setPage(nextPage)\n      \n      // 更新URL但不刷新页面\n      router.push(`/blog?page=${nextPage}`, undefined, { shallow: true })\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading more posts:', error)\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false)\n    }\n  }\n  \n  return (\n    <div className=\"blog-container\">\n      <h1>Blog</h1>\n      \n      <div className=\"posts-grid\">\n        {posts.map(post => (\n          <div key={post.id} className=\"post-card\">\n            <Link href={`/blog/${post.slug}`}>\n              <a>\n                <h2>{post.title}</h2>\n                <p>{post.excerpt}</p>\n                <time>{new Date(post.publishedAt).toLocaleDateString()}</time>\n              </a>\n            </Link>\n          </div>\n        ))}\n      </div>\n      \n      {page < totalPages && (\n        <div className=\"load-more-container\">\n          <button \n            onClick={loadMorePosts} \n            disabled={loading}\n            className=\"load-more-btn\"\n          >\n            {loading ? 'Loading...' : 'Load More Posts'}\n          </button>\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// 获取初始博客文章\nexport async function getStaticProps() {\n  const posts = await GetPaginatedPosts(1)\n  const totalPages = Math.ceil(await GetAllPosts().length / 6) // 每页6篇文章\n  \n  return {\n    props: {\n      initialPosts: posts,\n      totalPages\n    },\n    revalidate: 3600 // 每小时重新生成\n  }\n}\n```\n\n## 总结\n\nNext.js为React应用提供了强大的服务端渲染能力，通过这三篇文章的介绍，我们全面了解了：\n\n1. **SSR与SSG的区别**：SSR在请求时渲染，SSG在构建时渲染\n2. **数据获取方法**：getServerSideProps、getStaticProps和getStaticPaths\n3. **路由系统**：基本路由、动态路由和捕获所有路由\n4. **API路由**：构建全栈应用的能力\n5. **样式与优化**：CSS模块、图片优化和构建配置\n6. **实际应用**：电商网站和博客系统的实现\n\nNext.js的选择取决于你的应用需求：\n\n- **内容驱动网站**：使用SSG获得最佳性能\n- **个性化内容**：使用SSR提供动态内容\n- **混合应用**：结合SSR和SSG，根据页面特性选择合适的渲染方式\n\n通过Next.js，你可以构建出高性能、SEO友好且用户体验优秀的React应用。无论是博客、电商网站还是企业应用，Next.js都能提供合适的解决方案。掌握Next.js的高级特性和最佳实践，将使你在现代Web开发中具备更强的竞争力。"
